name: cpu-model
rationale: The first complete CO2 lattice-energy pair combines a GPU crystal with a CPU molecule. Compare the accepted crystal against the CPU model on the same host and exact binary from its final k-point WFN. Keep geometry, full symmetry reduction, 3x3x3 k-points, basis, cutoff, quadrature, dispersion and EPS_SCF unchanged. This is a numerical control, not an additional base result or canonical acceptance replay.
comparison: (E_crystal_CPU - E_crystal_GPU) / 4 * 2625.4996394799 kJ/mol; retain sign and compare magnitude to the provisional 0.5 kJ/mol numerical target
